name: FCC gasoline post-treating (Prime-G+, SCANfining)
principle: FCC gasoline carries most of a refinery's gasoline-pool sulfur and most of its olefins, which supply octane. Post-treating removes sulfur with limited octane loss. In Axens Prime-G+ a first-step selective hydrogenation unit makes an olefin-rich light cracked naphtha, a naphtha splitter is optional, and the sulfur-rich heavy cracked naphtha goes to selective hydrodesulfurisation.
